## Starbucks to Participate in the 2026 Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference


11/24/2026


Download (opens in new window)


SEATTLE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that Cathy Smith, evp, chief financial officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference on Wednesday, December 2nd, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. Eastern Time.


The fireside chat will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at[https://investor.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.starbucks.com&esheet=54644946&newsitemid=20261124617463&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.starbucks.com&index=1&md5=5455d74768a9b10ca72617e4f7db8060) on the Events & Presentations page.


**About Starbucks**


Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to responsibly sourcing and roasting high-quality *arabica* coffee. Today, with a global footprint of more than 41,000 company-operated and licensed coffeehouses and a growing presence in consumer-packaged goods, we are the world's premier purveyor of specialty coffee. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique *Starbucks Experience* to life for every customer through every cup. To share in the experience, please visit us in our coffeehouses or online at[about.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fabout.starbucks.com%2F&esheet=54644946&newsitemid=20261124617463&lan=en-US&anchor=about.starbucks.com&index=2&md5=ee908fae2de92995676648ebf9ebad8f) or[www.starbucks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.starbucks.com&esheet=54644946&newsitemid=20261124617463&lan=en-US&anchor=www.starbucks.com&index=3&md5=fbb9a3cadc7967a651d41901792e738d) .
